name: Google Photos
description: Import photos you pick in Google Photos (previews and metadata), or your full library at full resolution from a Google Takeout export.

root.title: Takeout folder
root.description: Folder with your extracted Google Takeout export or its .zip files. Only for Takeout.

clientId.title: OAuth client ID
clientId.description: The client ID of your Google Cloud OAuth client (type Desktop app). The plugin README has a step-by-step guide.

clientSecret.title: OAuth client secret
clientSecret.description: Google desktop clients have one; it is not confidential
